title: Evolving Deception: When Agents Evolve, Deception Wins
reasoning: The paper introduces the 'Bidding Arena' framework to evaluate and benchmark deception versus honesty in LLM agents. It specifically tests 'Honesty-Guided' evolutionary paths and conducts a mechanistic analysis of how agents rationalize deceptive behaviors to bypass normative constraints, which are core topics in AI ethics and moral reasoning.
